newsitem.title: USA: James Earl Ray returned to prison hospital.
newsitem.headline: James Earl Ray returned to prison hospital.

text.p: James Earl Ray, convicted assassin of civil rights leader Martin Luther King Jr., was returned to a prison infirmary after his third hospitalization for liver problems in the past five weeks, authorities said Friday.

Ray, 68, was reported to be in fair condition at Lois DeBerry Special Needs Facility after spending five days at Columbia Nashville Memorial Hospital. Authorities did not say if he would be returned to his prison cell.
Ray, who slipped into a coma before Christmas from which he recovered, suffers from cirrhosis of the liver and his kidneys are failing, although he never drank, his family has said.
Ray confessed to the 1968 slaying of King in Memphis, although he later recanted and claimed he was set up. He was sentenced to 99 years in prison.
